title: feat(nm2frm2lprd3n3): distance-3 neighbor-read of L-path cyclic-frame transport -e3 then +e1 at t+1 on three-axis opposite near-face seed: r
science: Distance-3 of the L-path (-e3 then +e1) on the three-axis near-face seed. The band's cleanest demonstration that the (reverse,face) pair is lossy: the bare L-path HOLDs at face probe (0,0,1) and fails at both reverse probes, and the two conjuncts of the readout fail on OPPOSITE probe pairs (reverse dies on the L-path, face dies on the empty witness shell) -- yet everything collapses to (fail,fail). The note names this 'the complementary case' and then reports the same two letters as ten other members. Recomputed exact.
